owned_child.routing: owned child(native-1) -> operator 192.168.100.170:37535 (own frame proxy) -> repair hub :18080

owner_reference.note: owned child Agent uses the exact repair Agent binary; process owner is the harness on native-1, never a nodesteer-agent*.service unit

desired_change.scenario: the owned child is cut from the Hub, then a real Desired State change (script content v1 -> v2) is committed on the Hub. The change must survive the Hub restart and the reconnecting Agent must reconcile to it.
